RESULTS & INDICATORS

What VIRD will monitor

VIRD measures not only what programmes deliver, but the changes they create. Figures will be published only after verification through VIRD's MEAL and financial systems.

Reach and inclusion

People reached, households supported, communities served, children supported, women empowered, youth trained and farmers supported.

Services and opportunity

Jobs and livelihoods created, water systems established, schools supported, health and nutrition outcomes, and sanitation improvements.

Lasting change

Community resilience, environmental outcomes and Islamic social investment mobilized.

Stories of change

Stories will show the challenge, intervention, change, beneficiary or community voice, and future priorities. Every story will follow safeguarding, consent, privacy and ethical storytelling standards.

MEAL

Evidence. Accountability. Learning.

VIRD's Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability & Learning system supports relevant, effective, efficient, inclusive, accountable and sustainable programmes.

How MEAL supports delivery

Baselines, routine monitoring, outcome tracking, beneficiary feedback, evaluations, learning reviews, data analysis, impact reporting and adaptive programme management.

Future dashboard

A live or periodically updated impact dashboard is planned. Placeholder figures will not be published as results until verified.
